location_qualifier: Hills 60, 61 and 62, south of the 64th Field Artillery positions
current_activity: in position on Hills 60, 61 and 62, supporting the 27th Infantry
notes: Miller, ch. XI: on 10 January 1943 the 8th Field Artillery Battalion (105-mm howitzers) was in direct support of the 27th Infantry and had selected positions on Hills 60, 61 and 62, south of the 64th and about 3,000 yards east of the easternmost hill in the 27th Infantry's zone. A landing day is not copied. Confidence 0.5: Miller only in this increment.
